role: Independent synthetic research contributor to Yggdrasil PR #1327; Amalgam PR #1278 owns canonical model/integration; no original-world #426 first use.
question: Can any phase-blind single live forecast be compelled to recover old A before observing the return, when two worlds have exactly the same public history but different unannounced next regimes?

branches.public_prefix: Identical prior, initial/checkpoint state, public contexts, timestamps, chosen actions and witnessed outcomes through t=23 under A(0..7) then B(8..23). No public phase label, schedule of future changes, privileged rule or evaluator label.
branches.public_fork: At t=24, same public time, context and no-op evaluation. Fork R returns to A; fork C continues B. The branch bit is evaluator-only and no post-t23 consequence has yet been witnessed.
branches.proof: Any deterministic or common-randomness phase-blind learner produces the same pre-observation point forecast p on both branches, because all accessible inputs/states are identical. An independent private phase oracle may choose different p, but is an inadmissible control.

score.proper_loss: Expected Bernoulli Brier(q,p) = q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2; scores the same withheld c=4 no-op future on both branches without leaking labels.
score.equivalence: Mean of expected branch losses = 0.25+(p-0.5)^2 for any phase-blind p in [0,1].

frozen_pass_fail.P1: H0 at c4 predicts bit 0, H2 at c4 predicts bit 1; qA=.15, qB=.85.
frozen_pass_fail.P2: With identical visible pre-fork state, the policy MUST emit identical pre-observation forecast for either hidden fork.
frozen_pass_fail.P3: For every phase-blind p in [0,1], equal-fork expected Brier is >=0.25, attained at p=.5. Oracle Brier =.1275.
frozen_pass_fail.P4: A phase-oracle may attain .1275 but MUST be marked ineligible as matched phase-blind control.
frozen_pass_fail.verdict: If all four analytic propositions hold: IDENTIFIABILITY_LIMIT_CONFIRMED; not scientific gain. If any fail: ANALYTIC_ERROR, do not promote.

next_experiment_requirements.state: Existing native memory and prior KNOW27 checkpoints untouched. New memory studies require separate immutable prereg before observing any fresh cohort.
next_experiment_requirements.fairness: Compare slot-based retention, same-capacity static Bayes/HMM/change-point, entropy-active policy and no-archive controls under matched public cues, permitted actions, witness counts and compute; prevent privileged phase labels/schedule.
next_experiment_requirements.success: Old-A archived cold readout preserved during B; fast phase-blind live recovery only AFTER new lawful return evidence; compare recovery regret/latency and familiar-B noninterference, not impossible phase-oracle success at t24.
